scopes.name: Fix duplicate usage API polling (#216)
scopes.notes: Ported both backend cache (30s TTL + 429 retry-after) and frontend singleton polling (ref-counted with exponential backoff). Fork code was nearly identical to upstream base.

scopes.name: Show non-git directories in workspace selector (#217/#218)
scopes.notes: Added isGitRepo field to RepositoryInfo (Rust + TS), non-git dirs at depth 1, guarded git UI in PreLaunchCard, added .langfuse/ to .gitignore

scopes.name: Session renaming with backend persistence (#220)
scopes.notes: Added name field to Rust SessionConfig, rename_session method + Tauri command. Updated frontend renameSession to invoke backend. Fork already had sidebar + header rename UI.

scopes.name: Expand file drag/drop to all file types in terminals
scopes.notes: Removed IMAGE_EXTENSIONS filter, accept all file drops. Added quote wrapping for paths with spaces.

scopes.name: Fix stale session cleanup on kill_all_sessions
scopes.notes: Added clear_all() to SessionManager. Updated kill_all_sessions command to clear session records and unregister from status server alongside PTY cleanup.

scopes.name: Relax instance_id validation for reconnecting sessions
scopes.notes: Relaxed instance_id check in status_server.rs: known/registered sessions with wrong instance_id are accepted with a warning log. Unknown sessions still get 403.

scopes.name: Add file path text input to open-file session pane
scopes.notes: Added text input in OpenFile section of PreLaunchCard. Supports absolute and relative paths (resolved against projectPath). Clear button, Enter to submit. Wired via new onSetFilePath prop through TerminalGrid.

scopes.name: File system explorer tab in sidebar
scopes.notes: Added list_directory Rust command with filtering/sorting. Created FileExplorer.tsx with lazy-load tree, context menu (open as file session, copy path, copy relative path), dedup detection for existing file sessions. Added 'Files' tab to sidebar between Config and Processes. Drag-to-terminal deferred.
